content.text: Two bugs: `topo.signature` contains lists, and `sys.environ` needs `os` imported. Fixing:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/submission && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p = 'crosscheck/topology.py'
s = open(p).read()
s = s.replace("self.external_ids = sorted(self.id_of[name] for name in raw[\"external_nodes\"])",
              "self.external_ids = tuple(sorted(self.id_of[name] for name in raw[\"external_nodes\"]))")
s = s.replace("self.demand_pairs = tuple(\n            (s, d) for s in self.external_ids for d in self.external_ids if s != d\n        )",
              "self.demand_pairs = tuple(\n            (s, d) for s in self.external_ids for d in self.external_ids if s != d\n        )")
s = s.replace("self.signature = (self.flows, self.caps, self.external_ids)",
              "self.signature = (self.flows, self.caps, self.external_ids)")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p = 'main.py'
s = open(p).read()
s = s.replace("import json\nimport math\nimport sys\nimport traceback",
              "import json\nimport math\nimport os\nimport sys\nimport traceback")
s = s.replace("if __debug__ and sys.environ.get(\"CROSSCHECK_DEBUG\"):",
              "if os.environ.get(\"CROSSCHECK_DEBUG\"):")
open(p,'w').write(s)
print("patched")
EOF
grep -n "external_ids = tuple\|signature\|import os\|CROSSCHECK_DEBUG" /workspace/submission/crosscheck/topology.py /workspace/submission/main.py
